title: Soft deletion marks item with deleted status instead of physical removal
gherkin:
Given an item exists in the system
When the item is soft-deleted
Then the item record remains in the database
And the item's status is marked as deleted in the technical status model
rationale: Validates the core soft deletion mechanism—items must not be physically removed but instead marked with a deleted status in the database. This ensures data integrity and audit trails.
